title.narrative: Moving Integrated, Quality Maternal, Newborn, Child Health and Family Planning and Reproductive Health Services to Scale (MOMENTUM/Tiyeni) Activity Component 1

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Moving Integrated, Quality Maternal, Newborn, Child Health and Family Planning and Reproductive Health (MNCH/FP/RH) Services to Scale (MOMENTUM/Tiyeni) activity will support the Government of Malawi's effort to reduce maternal, newborn, and child morbidity and mortality through improved access and quality of health service delivery in seven districts. It will focus on MNCH; voluntary FP/RH; nutrition; water, sanitation, and hygiene; and malaria prevention and treatment. It will deploy integrated and age-appropriate interventions through facility and community-based approaches. With FY 2022 funds, MOMENTUM/Tiyeni will: 1) provide mentorship, coaching, and supervision of health workers in targeted districts, 2) contribute towards ending child, early, and forced marriages, 3) support health governance and accountability using data for decision-making, quality improvement activities, and civil society organizations engagement, 4) provide targeted market-based technical assistance to expand the private sector's role in health service delivery, and provide technical assistance to Government-to-Government supported districts, 5) support social and behavior change interventions to improve health-seeking behaviors, and maximize access to life-saving commodities and high-quality health services, and 6) improve communication between health providers and clients, families, and couples. The activity will support contingency plans to respond to health needs during and after climate related emergencies, The activity will also use timely surveillance data to forecast health outcomes and adjust program objectives to optimize results through adaptive management to mitigate outbreaks..The activity supports the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and can contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work..
